## Pre-Submission Checklist

- [ ] I have searched [existing issues](https://github.com/ind4skylivey/0ptiscaler4linux/issues?q=is%3Aissue) and confirmed this feature has NOT already been requested
- [ ] I have checked the [documentation/wiki](https://github.com/ind4skylivey/0ptiscaler4linux/wiki) and this feature does not already exist
- [ ] This feature is relevant to OptiScaler Universal's core purpose (GPU upscaling on Linux) — NOT a general Linux gaming feature
- [ ] I understand that vague or low-effort requests will be closed without discussion

## Problem Statement

<!-- What specific problem or limitation does this feature solve? Be concrete. -->
<!-- BAD: "The installer could be better." -->
<!-- GOOD: "When running install.sh on systems with hybrid GPU (iGPU + dGPU), the script does not detect which GPU the target game will use, leading to incorrect profile selection." -->


## Proposed Solution

<!-- Describe how the feature should work. Include enough detail for someone to implement it. -->


## Who Benefits?

<!-- Who would use this feature? How many users would it help? -->
<!-- e.g., "All users with AMD GPUs on Wayland who need..." -->


## Alternatives Considered

<!-- What other approaches could solve the same problem? Why is your proposal better? -->


## Additional Context

<!-- Mockups, diagrams, references to similar tools, or any other context. -->
